winner_title: El Aplauso Lluvioso de su Danza
first_read_mechanism: Traditional dancers remain visually forceful through torrential rain; weather and gesture transform a familiar event.
decisive_moment: Dancing persists while rain becomes visible structure.
light_shadow: Rain and ambient conditions, not a formal light formula.
familiarity: Cultural event rediscovered through weather and timing.
transfers_to_2026: Wait for architecture, weather, and human action to become inseparable in one frame.
does_not_transfer: The 2023 cultural theme does not establish an architecture-specific formula.

first_read_mechanism: Rare shadow behavior differentiates a location already photographed many times.
decisive_moment: Shadows and urban characters align in a fleeting composition.
person_action: Characters give life to the urban environment.
familiarity: Familiar place made uncommon by time and light.
transfers_to_2026: A saturated building can remain viable when a rare relationship is visible immediately.
does_not_transfer: Drone access and dramatic shadow are not requirements; neither should become a style prescription.

first_read_mechanism: A solitary figure and metro concrete patterns turn accelerated infrastructure into contemplation.
decisive_moment: The figure pauses above repeated station geometry.
light_shadow: Warm/cool light contrast was explicitly praised.
familiarity: Everyday infrastructure rediscovered as contemplative space.
transfers_to_2026: Infrastructure, geometry, and one restrained human verb can carry an architectural story.
does_not_transfer: Solitary figures, metros, and formal pattern are not guaranteed preferences for the 2026 jury.
